messages:
marco: Quick async check — where are we on the private-region / on-prem readiness checklist for ap-southeast-1? owners + blockers?
sana: Owners: infra = @liz, runtime = @dmitri, compliance = @carl. Milestones: infra VPC setup (eta 3/24), routing policy tests (3/26), KMS onboarding (3/28). Main blocker: KMS key rotation flow needs HSM access confirmation from infra team.
liz: infra update: VPC & subnets created; peering pending docs from security. Need CIDR ranges from customer onboarding for dedicated VPCs. Also verifying egress NAT gateways for telemetry.
dmitri: runtime update: PR for region-aware routing landed (GH: rwd/route/396). Need a second reviewer for the policy fallback logic — @sana or @marco? Small change, mostly tests.
sana: I'll take the review tomorrow morning. Important: ensure fallback selects nearest compatible model variant (quantized) if dedicated capacity is constrained.
manika: (oops wrong channel)
anika: Product note: schedule for customer beta still targetting week of 4/1. Need gating checklist done earlier. Also we need a clear messaging doc for customers about data residency guarantees.
carl: Compliance: KMS/HSM is the major legal ask. Need to validate key import/export constraints and add audit log retention settings. I've started a doc in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/regions/apac-kms-guidelines — comments welcome.
marco: Can someone drop the minimal routing policy config we'll use for canary tests? want to share with QA.
dmitri: Pasted config below (canary picks eu/ap based on region tag + latency threshold):
```json
{
  "policy": "latency_then_residency",
  "rules": [
    {"if": "request.region == 'ap-southeast-1' && region.capable", "route": "ap-dedicated"},
    {"if": "latency < 120ms && model.variant == 'standard'", "route": "hosted-fast"},
    {"else": "route": "hosted-quantized"}
  ],
  "fallback": "hosted-quantized"
}
```
liz: note: need to wire in the `region.capable` boolean from infra capability API (endpoint: /v1/regions/capabilities). I opened infra ticket INFRA-1142 to add a flag for onprem-ready.
carl: also add `data_residency_tag` to requests so we can enforce routing by customer data contract.
sana: will add tests to the runtime suite to assert routing honors data_residency_tag and doesn't leak across regions.
marco: dmitri — can you add the canary config to the runtime test harness and drop the PR link here when ready?
dmitri: yes. PR will be up before EOD. pinging @liz for infra endpoint dependency.
liz: noted — INFRA-1142 will be prioritized after today's patch window, ETA 2 days.
anika: customer comms: can one of you draft a 2-line beta blurb for account managers? I can polish.
sana: I'll draft and post by EOD.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled non-prod canary deploy for ap-southeast-1 at 2026-03-22T02:00Z — will notify on status.
marco: thanks all. Action items: dmitri add PR; liz finish INFRA-1142; carl finalize KMS doc; sana add tests + draft blurb; anika prepare beta comms timeline. Check-in in this thread tomorrow for blockers. :thumbsup:
